<p style="font-size:0.9rem;color:#6c757d;margin-bottom:2rem;">
Teaching at the Norwegian University of Life Sciences (NMBU) since 2021, and previously at the University of Klagenfurt, Austria.
</p>

<h2>Current Courses at NMBU</h2>

<div style="display:grid;gap:1rem;margin-bottom:2.5rem;">

<div style="background:white;border:1px solid #dde4ed;border-radius:8px;padding:1.25rem 1.5rem;">
<h3 style="margin:0 0 0.4rem;font-size:1rem;color:#1a3a5c;">
<a href="https://gammel.nmbu.no/course/DAT200" target="_blank">DAT200 — Applied Machine Learning</a>
</h3>
<p style="font-size:0.82rem;color:#6c757d;margin-bottom:0.6rem;">NMBU · Spring semester · Annual · 250 hours workload</p>
<p style="font-size:0.9rem;margin:0;">Introduction to machine learning methodology using modern computing tools. Topics: preprocessing, feature extraction (PCA, LDA), feature selection, visualisation, scaling, and data formatting. Heavy focus on practical applications.</p>
</div>

<div style="background:white;border:1px solid #dde4ed;border-radius:8px;padding:1.25rem 1.5rem;">
<h3 style="margin:0 0 0.4rem;font-size:1rem;color:#1a3a5c;">
<a href="https://gammel.nmbu.no/course/DAT300" target="_blank">DAT300 — Applied Deep Learning</a>
</h3>
<p style="font-size:0.82rem;color:#6c757d;margin-bottom:0.6rem;">NMBU · Autumn semester · Annual · 250 hours workload</p>
<p style="font-size:0.9rem;margin:0;">Builds on DAT200. Covers foundations of artificial neural networks, deep CNNs, RNNs, autoencoders, variational autoencoders, GANs, and transformers. Heavy focus on applications and real-data modelling.</p>
</div>

<div style="background:white;border:1px solid #dde4ed;border-radius:8px;padding:1.25rem 1.5rem;">
<h3 style="margin:0 0 0.4rem;font-size:1rem;color:#1a3a5c;">
<a href="https://gammel.nmbu.no/emne/INF221" target="_blank">INF221 — Computer Science for Data Scientists</a>
</h3>
<p style="font-size:0.82rem;color:#6c757d;margin-bottom:0.6rem;">NMBU · Previous course</p>
<p style="font-size:0.9rem;margin:0;">Foundations of computer science tailored for data science students — algorithms, data structures, and programming paradigms relevant to ML workflows.</p>
</div>

</div>
